_comment: Golden classification vectors shared by the JS action (github-action/index.test.js) and the Python server (tests/test_policy_binding.py). Both must agree on the strongest required action type for each change. 'expected' is the strongest action type a change requires under the given policy. Keep this in sync with .inntris.yml.

cases.name: docs into a feature branch is a low-risk attestation
docs into main is a protected_branch_merge
workflow change off a protected branch
workflow + docs into main escalates to the merge gate
infra is a production_deployment even off a protected branch
infra + workflow into a release branch picks the strongest
migrations (not path-mapped) into main gate via the branch
unmapped file off a protected branch is repo_change
release/* does not cross a slash
